title: One Program per Fill: Counter Application of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
Exactly one program of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is applied to any one fill.

## Clauses

1. **Selection.** Among the patient's active programs that are eligible for the fill, the program with the lowest application priority is applied, and the others are not applied to that fill, whatever amounts they would give.
2. **Manner of application.** Each program is applied at the counter by its own method: a cash-price-table program prices a cash fill; a secondary-claim program is billed after the insurance claim; a free-drug-claim program supplies the fill at no cost.
3. **Relation to insurance.** A program that does not pay after insurance is applied only to a fill that is not billed to insurance. A program that pays after insurance is applied only after the insurance claim is paid, and then to the patient pay that claim assigned.
4. **Discount card and club.** A Kestrel Rx Discount Card and a Kestrel Rx Savings Club membership are never open at the same time: when a club membership is activated, an open discount card on the same profile is cancelled the same day.
5. **Household members.** A patient covered as a household member of another patient's Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family membership does not also hold an individual club membership.
6. **Bridge and copay card.** A Manufacturer Bridge Program is never used for a fill that a manufacturer copay card for the same drug could pay after an approved insurance claim.

The application priority, whether a program pays after insurance, and its counter method are settings of each program type.

## Decision table (hypothetical profiles)

| Active eligible programs for the fill | Program applied |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Copay Card (priority 1) and Charitable Foundation Copay Grant (priority 2) | Manufacturer Copay Card only |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual (priority 5) alone, fill not billed to insurance | The club membership |
| A program that does not pay after insurance, fill billed to insurance | Not that program |

*Hypothetical case:* a patient activates a Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual membership on a given day while holding an open Kestrel Rx Discount Card. The discount card is cancelled that same day.
